boundary: This artifact may inform the separate algorithm-development dialogue but does not change the algorithm by itself.

highest_value_routes.idea: Total Commander style side-by-side read-only comparison with equal regions hidden.
ArtMoney/Zeller style repeated controlled narrowing over already-materialized state.
Align executions before diffing so reordering or different trace length does not masquerade as a causal difference.
Intersect differential slice with proof/dependency/dynamic slices rather than trusting either alone.
Mine candidate invariants on controls and ask where hostile traces first violate them; every inferred invariant remains hypothesis-only until proved.
Rsync/Merkle-style fingerprints can let SPIDER skip identical large trace/state regions, with exact canonical verification behind hash screening.

do_not_import_as_algorithm: SAT-DIFF or MaxSAT as a hidden runtime oracle
Daikon likely invariants as proof lemmas
any paper ranking or external benchmark result as theorem evidence

search content-addressed/Merkle/rsync techniques for scalable comparison
search invariant mining and counterexample-guided diagnostics
